hipster.alt: Illustration: four people laughing around a table, one holding up a vinyl record, cards dated 2007 and tokens laid out in front of them

spritelab.alt: The pixel-art editor: drawing canvas in the middle, layer stack and colour palette either side
The animation timeline, a row of frames with onion-skin preview
Hitbox, hurtbox and pushbox overlays drawn on a sprite
The AI generation panel: a text prompt, a quality selector and a live cost estimate

aura.alt: The AURA console: a navigation rail on the left, the conversation in the middle, and the robot’s camera and live activity on the right
A person's profile in the brain panel: facts grouped by category, each with wiki-style links to topics
The knowledge graph: a person node surrounded by facts, skills and the topics they mention
An assembled Reachy Mini: a white rounded body, a head with two dark camera eyes, and two coiled wire antennae

bullyoff.alt: A match in progress: the pitch seen from the side with both teams as numbered discs, a tactics panel on the left and live possession, circle entries and shot counts on the right
The club picker: two tiers of invented clubs with their crests, founding years and squad levels, and a detail panel for the selected club
A generated world: 24 clubs, 698 players, 20 seasons and zero real names, beside a ledger of invented champions going back to 2010
The title screen: a floodlit pitch being watered at dusk, over the line "Take the bench on Saturday"

hockeyeleven.alt: An 11v11 match on a blue water pitch: both teams in the middle third, the scoreboard reading BEL 0 - 0 NED, a radar of the whole pitch along the bottom and the keyboard controls bottom right
Indoor hockey: a dark six-a-side rink with white side boards, the ball being carried out of the circle past the goalkeeper
The nation picker: a searchable grid of flags with three-letter codes and ratings, filtered to Europe, over the line "All 133 FIH associations"
The match setup screen: the three formats side by side, the two line-ups with their world ranks, and pickers for formation, venue, weather, squad, length and level

please-do-not-throw-richie.alt: The exhibition floor at Devoxx Belgium: sponsor stands along the walls, a few developers, and Richie small and white in the middle of the carpet
Richie beside Voxxy on the exhibition floor, with the prompt E: Voxxy can help
Richie at the foot of the grand staircase, which climbs to the foyer and cinema level
The auditorium: rows of red seats and an audience facing the lit screen, while security shouts Hey! No robots!

runtime-rumble.alt: The title screen: RUNTIME RUMBLE over the closed exhibition hall, the five robots lined up in front of the booths, and the arcade, versus and chaos modes on the right
Voxxy and Droid fighting in front of the Robo-Barista and Gadget Lab booths, health bars along the top and a 2 hit combo in the middle
The fighter select: Voxxy, Droid, Biggy, Richie Mini and Microduck side by side, with speed, power, mass and reach for the selected one
Two Biggys fighting in the auditorium in front of a seated crowd, under a sign reading Please silence your robots
